tldr: Evening batch (Sep 9): Anthropic declined to submit Claude Mythos 5.1 to Britain's AI Safety Institute for pre-release testing — the model is open only to vetted US institutions, stoking Whitehall fears that safety-test access is becoming an export-control function. Cognition raises $2B+ at a $48B valuation (a16z/Accel) to scale Devin as agent run-rate revenue nears $900M. Hugging Face's budget-capped autonomous ML Intern lands inside HuggingChat (~$0.50 per demo run). DeepSeek's first multimodal V4 — Vision-Exp, 285B MoE — runs on 10-12 consumer RTX 3090s, and Xiaomi previews MiMo-X-Pro/Flash for professional workflows. Hermes Agent adds Perplexity Search API to its provider-agnostic search layer; the OpenAI Navier-Stokes saga escalates as Buckmaster alleges academic fraud and Altman pushes back.

articles.title: Anthropic withheld its latest model from UK testers
articles.summary: Claude Mythos 5.1 wasn't submitted to Britain's AI Safety Institute — open only to vetted US labs; Whitehall fears a new precedent.

articles.title: HF's ML Intern now runs inside HuggingChat
articles.summary: Budget-capped autonomous ML engineer: describe an idea in chat, it quotes a compute budget, trains and pushes results — ~$0.50 a demo run.

articles.title: Cognition raises $2B+ at a $48B valuation to scale Devin
articles.summary: Series E led by a16z and Accel nearly doubles May's $26B round; Devin run-rate revenue up to ~$900M, ~90% of Cognition's own code Devin-written.

articles.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp runs on 10-12x RTX 3090s
articles.summary: First multimodal V4 (285B MoE, FP4+FP8, ~157GB) on consumer Ampere via SM86 vLLM: 60+ tok/s on 10 GPUs, 120+ on 12, at a 240W cap.

articles.title: Xiaomi previews MiMo-X-Pro and MiMo-X-Flash models
articles.summary: MiMo-X early-access pair surfaces in MiMo Desktop preview — aimed at professional workflows with a focus on complex reasoning and multi-step tasks.

articles.title: Hermes Agent adds Perplexity Search API as a provider

articles.title: Paper: lossless LLM speedups via discrete diffusion
articles.summary: 'Unlocking Lossless Speedups in LLMs via Discrete Diffusion' — a diffusion route to faster inference without quality loss, circulating on HF Papers.
